support.loadFailedDescription: No case was modified. Try again to recover the information.
support.subjectPlaceholder: E.g. I can't publish to Instagram
support.bodyPlaceholder: What you were doing, what you expected to happen and what happened instead.
support.createFailed: We couldn't create the case. Please try again.
support.emptyTitle: You don't have support cases yet
support.emptyDescription: When you need help, open a case and you'll have the whole conversation here.
support.ticketLoadFailed: We couldn't load this support case.
support.ticketNotFoundDescription: The case doesn't exist or is no longer available in this workspace.
support.messageRequired: Write a message before sending it.
support.replyFailed: We couldn't send your reply. Please try again.
support.resolveFailed: We couldn't mark the case as resolved.

teams.manageDescription: Manage people, assigned accounts and workspace invitations.
teams.viewDescription: Check your role, the available accounts and who's part of the workspace.
teams.loadFailedDescription: No access was modified. Try loading the section again.
teams.adminAllAccounts: Administration can access every active account in the workspace.
teams.adminHint: Accesses every account and can manage members, except other administrators.
teams.memberHint: Only works with the accounts you assign.
teams.inviteDescription: The invitation is private, tied to this email and expires in seven days.
teams.invitationOnlyEmail: Only {email} can accept it before it expires.
teams.membersEmptyFilteredDescription: Try another search to find someone in the workspace.
teams.invitationsEmptyDescription: New invitations show up here until they're accepted, expire or are revoked.
teams.invitationsEmptyFilteredDescription: Try another search to find an invitation.
teams.activityFailedDescription: The workspace activity couldn't be retrieved.
teams.activityEmptyDescription: Changes to invitations, roles, accounts and ownership show up here.
teams.activityEmptyFilteredDescription: Try another search or remove the category filter.

confirm.removeDescription: {name} will lose access to the workspace and their active sessions will be closed.
confirm.revokeDescription: The invitation for {email} will stop being valid.
confirm.transferDescription: {name} will become the new owner. Your role will change to Administration.
confirm.leaveDescription: You'll lose access to its accounts and your active sessions will be closed.

invitation.unavailableDescription: No further change was made to your account.
invitation.invitedTitle: You've been invited to a workspace
invitation.invitedDescription: Confirm your account to join. The invitation only works with {email}.

missing.title: The invitation link is missing
missing.description: Open the full link you received by email again.

invalid.title: This invitation isn't valid
invalid.description: The link may be incomplete or replaced by a newer invitation.

expired.title: This invitation expired
expired.description: Ask a workspace administrator to send you a new invitation.

used.title: This invitation was already used
used.description: Sign in to open your available workspaces.

full.title: The workspace reached its limit
full.description: The invitation is still pending, but an administrator must free a seat before you can join.

mismatch.title: The invitation belongs to another email
mismatch.description: Sign out and sign in with the account that received the invitation.

error.title: We couldn't check the invitation
error.description: Check your connection and try again.
